title: carthamus matritensis
intro: Carthamus matritensis, commonly known as Torrubia, is a plant species within the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant is believed to have health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Carthamus matritensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as sedative, diuretic, and antispasmodic effects.
